AES topic profiles

Settings

parametervaluemeaning
alpha0.1FDR threshold. A topic part is kept only if its q value is below this.
min_used5Use part: at least this many essays (both levels together) must use the topic before it is tested.
min_acc_users3Accuracy part: at least this many essays in each level must use the topic before accuracy is compared.
min_class8A boundary is modelled only if both levels have at least this many essays.
seed42Random seed for the internal cross-validation that chooses the regularisation strength.

Cross-validation: 5 folds × 3 repeats. A kept feature is stable if it is kept in at least 80% of folds and its coefficient has the same sign in at least 90% of them.

What separates the levels

Every topic part that the model uses at each boundary. Read down a column to see what separates two adjacent levels; read along a row to see where one topic matters.

Boundaries

Each pair of adjacent levels is analysed separately, using only essays from those two levels. Every topic has two parts: use (how often the topic is used) and accuracy (correct uses / all uses, only among essays that use it). A part is kept if it differs reliably between the two levels; AUC above 0.5 means the value is higher in the upper level. The highlighted table lists the kept parts, strongest first, with their typical value in each level.

A1/A2
